REDIRECTBERRY.name: Redirect Berry
REDIRECTBERRY.desc: The first super-effective hit is redirected to a random Pokémon instead
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

PHASESTONE.name: Phase Stone
PHASESTONE.desc: 10% chance to blink to a random spot on the map instead of taking a hit
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

SCATTERLENS.name: Scatter Lens
SCATTERLENS.desc: 25% chance for a projectile attack to fire double the projectiles
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

only.note: Only moves that throw something. Projectiles, arcing lobs and ricochets — these are the moves whose shots the lens can double:

BITTERCURE.name: Bitter Cure
BITTERCURE.desc: Pokémon you damage are cursed for 8s — their healing damages them instead
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

LIMITBREAKER.name: Limit Breaker
LIMITBREAKER.desc: Final-stage Great Ball only: +20% to every stat, and it plays Ultra Ball league
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

PRISMLENS.name: Prism Lens
PRISMLENS.desc: Beams refract: full damage to the target, then 50% and 25% to two nearby foes
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

only.note: Only beam moves. A beam is a sustained line that keeps damaging whatever it touches — these are the only moves in the game the lens can refract:

WITHERINGSHIELD.name: Withering Shield
WITHERINGSHIELD.desc: Damage taken -40% for the first 5s, -20% for the next 10s, -8% for the next 20s
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

PHOENIXFEATHER.name: Phoenix Feather
PHOENIXFEATHER.desc: Fire-type only: the first knockout leaves it at 1 HP — it ignites for 4s, heals to 30%, then burns every enemy nearby
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

CIRCUITBREAKER.name: Circuit Breaker
CIRCUITBREAKER.desc: Electric-type only: no single hit can take more than 20% of its max HP — and when one is stopped, a shockwave knocks nearby foes back and may paralyse them
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

SHARPBEAK.name: Sharp Beak
src: Skyla Gym Challenge — Round 2 and Round 3 prize (live now)

ANCHOR.name: Anchor
ANCHOR.desc: Water-type only: can't be knocked back or pulled, -30% damage while standing still, +10% Def and Sp. Def
src: Black Market — 1,000 coins, three on the shelf each window

PROTECTIVEPADS.name: Protective Pads
